text:
Marco: Heads up — nightly `ml-gpu/h100` job #8421 went red after the driver swap to 540.2. Seeing `invalid device function` during model warmup in the container. Full CI snippet below, can someone triage? https://ci.redwood/teams/ml/jobs/8421 :eyes:

ci-bot: Job ml-gpu/h100 #8421 failed — kernel_launch error: "invalid device function". Logs: /artifacts/8421/log.txt (truncated).

Jess: Any chance this is a PTX/SM mismatch? Can you paste `nvidia-smi` and `cat /usr/local/cuda/version.txt` from the failed node?

Marco: snippet:
```
Driver Version: 540.2
GPU 0: NVIDIA H100-SXM (UUID: GPU-xxxx)
CUDA Version: 12.2
```
`/usr/local/cuda/version.txt`: CUDA 12.2
`dmesg` extract: NVRM: GPU 0: invalid device function at 0x7f...

Rishi: 540.x rolled out to h100 pool last night (infra auto-roll). This looks like either a driver<->PTX mismatch or kernels compiled for a different SM. Two quick checks: 1) confirm container base image (is it prebuilt with sm_90?), 2) try forcing PTX fallback.

Jess: Also try reproducing locally with `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=90` or the matching arch. Example repro command:
```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=90 pytest tests/ops/test_chunked_attention.py -k warmup -q
```

Emily: If it is the driver, can we rerun the job on the stable pool (535.104) to bisect? @infra-bot could you queue a rerun on `h100-stable`? :pray:

infra-bot: Scheduled rerun of job 8421 on pool `h100-stable` (driver 535.104). Queue position: 2.

Marco: If rerun passes on 535 -> likely driver/rollout regression. If it still fails, we'll bisect the PRs that touched kernels.

Rishi: Quick notes: `invalid device function` often = compiled kernel targets don't include the device SM. For H100 we need sm_90 PTX or use PTX fallback. If the build pipeline switched to precompute SASS for sm_86 only, that'll break. I'll investigate the docker build step that emits `torch.utils.cpp_extension` flags.

Jess: Also check `libcudart.so` vs container CUDA version mismatch. Occasionally the node driver and container mismatch in subtle ways.

infra-bot: Rerun finished: job 8421 on h100-stable — PASSED ✅ (driver 535.104). Artifacts: /artifacts/8421/rerun-1/

Emily: Confirmed regression from the driver rollout. Rishi, can you open an infra PR to pin the h100 pool back to 535 until we validate 540 on canary? I'll notify infra oncall.

Rishi: Opening PR now to pin driver to 535. Will also schedule a small canary window on a separate pool and add a test that runs kernel warmup before promoting the driver.

Marco: Thanks all, appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:

Jess: Postmortem checklist suggestion: 1) add kernel warmup smoke in nightly, 2) add driver compatibility note in the image build, 3) vendor outreach if 540 is expected to be compatible.

Marco: Agreed — tagging this thread for the rollout postmortem.

Emily: I'll follow up with a short rollback timeline and make sure the Dedicated pools are unaffected.

Rishi: PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra/compare/pin-h100-driver-535 — will link test results shortly.
